safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Recording the allergy as “parasite” instead of a verified penicillin allergy can cause clinicians to miss a true beta-lactam allergy and inadvertently prescribe penicillin or related antibiotics, risking a serious allergic reaction including anaphylaxis. Allergy misdocumentation is high-risk because it directly affects medication safety decisions across future encounters.
